purpose: Run exact clean Core, Protocol, Runtime, Web, and Auth candidate sources through the existing G2/W02 and Auth G4 local workerd suites without accepting a hand-supplied target receipt.

subcohorts.actualBoundary: local workerd qualification Worker service binding -> target Worker's fetch handler -> Workers runtime HTTP handler -> generated G2 Rust/Wasm -> WebIngressEventFactory -> bound HTTP Endpoint Capability; the Wasm-trap lifecycle assertion remains a separate direct generated-Host call inside the same local workerd test
local workerd stream/WebSocket session leases remain distinct from rotating short-request generations
local workerd test -> generated Auth G4 Rust/Wasm -> Kernel -> OAuth Capability -> Auth private Host callback persistence fixture
subcohorts.transportClassification: This is a direct generated Wasm OAuth Capability invocation under workerd. It is not an HTTP ingress result.

doesNotProve: one fused product App containing every listed subcohort
external network ingress or a listening HTTP socket
deployed Worker routing or deployment configuration
production capacity, CPU, memory, fleet, SLO, resource isolation, or operations readiness
